packageRules.description: Patch, minor, digest and pin updates merge themselves once the branch is green and up to date with main, after the 3-day minimumReleaseAge, as in the sibling repos. Majors stay PRs. platformAutomerge arms GitHub auto-merge, which main's ruleset holds until test, windows and macos pass on an up-to-date branch; the merge is a merge commit like every other PR here. A merge to main releases nothing; a release is a tag.
